name: Lust & Meatballs
source:
In Lust & Meatballs, you have moved to a new town for college, and decide to take a job in a little pizza shop for extra money. You'll quickly make friends with your coworkers and customers, and a cast of interesting and sexy characters all over town. There will be no shortage of love interests to pursue, and you will get to choose who you would like to focus on as the story develops.​


*** First 6 chapters are kinetic, but all future updates will include multiple choices and branching paths that will impact the story going forward. ***
translation:
在《欲望与肉丸》中，你搬到了一个新的城镇上大学，并决定在一家小披萨店找一份工作来赚取额外的钱。你将很快与同事和客户以及全镇各地有趣而性感的人物成为朋友。不会缺少追求的爱情兴趣，随着故事的发展，你可以选择你想要关注的对象。​


*** 前6章是动态的，但所有未来的更新将包括多种选择和分支路径，这将影响故事的发展。***
